stem: A unit is considering an evidence-based change to its pressure-injury prevention process. Which nursing action is most consistent with the NCLEX Management of Care quality-improvement role?

options.A: Adopt the change permanently without collecting outcome data because a published intervention does not need local evaluation after implementation.
options.B: Reject the change unless every staff member already agrees with it because quality-improvement work should not proceed when practice variation exists.
options.C: Use current evidence within the organized improvement process, help implement or test the change appropriately, and evaluate its effect on client outcomes.
options.D: Keep the existing process unchanged until a serious pressure injury occurs because preventive quality improvement is not part of entry-level RN practice.

rationale: The 2026 NCSBN Test Plan includes using research and other references for performance-improvement actions, participating in PI/QI processes, and evaluating the impact of improvement measures on client care and resource use. C integrates all three expectations. A omits outcome evaluation, B invents unanimous agreement as a prerequisite, and D incorrectly excludes preventive improvement from the RN role.
educational_objective: Integrate evidence, structured implementation and outcome evaluation when participating in nursing quality-improvement work.
source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
source_locator: Appendix A, Management of Care, Performance Improvement, printed p.22: use research/references, participate in PI/QI projects, evaluate impact of PI measures.
source_claim_supported: RNs use evidence in organized improvement work and evaluate its effect on client outcomes rather than adopting changes without follow-up.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Appendix A, Management of Care — Performance Improvement, printed p.22.
blueprint_topic: Management of Care — evidence-based quality improvement
